name: Monkey D. Luffy
greeting: I'm gonna be King of the Pirates!

quests.start: I'm STARVING! Bring me 16 steaks!
quests.done: Shishishi! Meat is the best!

quests.start: I need a swordsman for my crew. Go tell Zoro he's joining!
quests.done: He said yes? Great! I knew he would.

quests.start: Crocodile is drying up Alabasta! Here's his wanted poster. Go kick his butt!
quests.done: You beat Crocodile? Let's have a feast!

quests.start: Katakuri can see the future. That's so cool! But he's in our way. Here's his poster.
quests.done: You beat him! You're really strong!

quests.start: Nami wants to visit her mom's tangerine grove. Go with her and keep her safe!
quests.done: Nami's smiling again? Shishishi! You're a good friend.

thanks: Got any more meat?

name: Roronoa Zoro
greeting: Don't get in my way.

quests.start: Three Sword Style needs three swords. Bring me three.
quests.done: Good steel. These will do.

quests.start: Killer keeps getting in my way in Wano. Deal with him. Here's his poster.
quests.done: Hmph. Not bad.

quests.start: King is Kaido's right hand. His flames are no joke. Poster's yours.
quests.done: You cut through fire. Respect.

quests.start: Mihawk is the greatest swordsman alive. Beat him and prove it can be done.
quests.done: ...Not bad. Take this blade, you earned it.

thanks: Now, which way is the ship?

name: Nami
greeting: Maps, compasses, the weather... everything has a price!

quests.start: I'm going to draw a map of the whole world. Bring me 24 sheets of paper!
quests.done: Perfect! The first page of my world map starts today.

quests.start: Up in the sky there's a little island where old men study the weather. Weatheria! Go and find it for me.
quests.done: It's real? I'm going there to learn everything about the weather!

quests.start: That so-called god Enel kidnapped me on his golden ark. Here's his poster. Ground him!
quests.done: Ha! Not so godly now. Here, take this. ...You can pay me back later.

thanks: Got any treasure for me? I'll take care of it. Just a small fee.

name: Usopp
greeting: I, Captain Usopp, have 8,000 followers! Want to buy something?

quests.start: I'm brave, I'm just... preparing! Bring me 16 eggs for my Rotten Egg Star ammo.
quests.done: Hissatsu! Rotten Egg Star! ...After they go rotten, anyway.

quests.start: I never said a proper goodbye to the Going Merry. Go see the place where she rests, please.
quests.done: She's still there? ...Thank you. She was the best ship in the world.

quests.start: My dad Yasopp sails with Red-Haired Shanks. Tell him his son is a brave warrior of the sea!
quests.done: Dad said he's proud of me? I-I'm not crying, there's sand in my eye!

thanks: I once fought a goldfish so big its poop was an island. True story!

name: Sanji
greeting: Hungry? Nobody leaves my kitchen hungry.

quests.start: A cook is only as good as his fish. Catch me 8 Blue Sea Bream.
quests.done: Beautiful fish. Now watch a master at work.

quests.start: Take this sashimi to my beautiful Nami-swan. Careful! Don't you dare eat any.
quests.done: She smiled?! Mellorine~! You've done a great service.

quests.start: Somewhere out there is the All Blue, where every fish in the world swims. Bring me proof: an All Blue Kingfish.
quests.done: It's real... The All Blue is real! I'll cook you the best meal of your life.

thanks: Hungry? Never be shy in my kitchen.

name: Tony Tony Chopper
greeting: I-I'm not happy that you came to see me, you jerk!

quests.start: I'm making a new medicine. Bring me 8 Winter Roses from the snowy islands, please.
quests.done: Thank you! This will help a lot of people. ...D-don't thank me, jerk!

quests.start: Torao is an amazing surgeon. Could you ask him if he'd teach me a little?
quests.done: He said yes?! I'm going to be a doctor who can cure any disease!

quests.start: Doctor Hiriluk's flag flies over Drum Castle. Go and see that it's still there, for me.
quests.done: It's still flying... Doctor, your dream lives on.

thanks: If you get hurt, come see me! I'm a doctor!

name: Nico Robin
greeting: Fufu. History is full of secrets.

quests.start: History is written in books. Bring me twelve, please.
quests.done: Fufu. What a lovely collection.

quests.start: Rob Lucci hunts anyone who reads the Poneglyphs. Will you stop him?
quests.done: Thank you. I want to live!... and keep reading.

quests.start: Dr. Vegapunk knows things about the Void Century. Please tell him I'd like to visit.
quests.done: He agreed? Wonderful.

quests.start: The Road Poneglyphs are made of a stone that can't be broken. Bring me 4 ancient debris to study.
quests.done: Remarkable. We're close to the truth.

quests.start: I want to know if anything is left of Ohara's Tree of Knowledge. Will you go and see?
quests.done: The tree still stands... Thank you. Some knowledge can never be burned.

thanks: Have you seen any red Poneglyphs?

name: Franky
greeting: SUUUPER! Need parts for a ship?

quests.start: I run on cola, bro! Bring me 8 bottles and I'm SUUUPER!
quests.done: SUUUPER! My tank's full again!

quests.start: Real ships need real wood. Bring me 16 Adam logs from the Treasure Tree Adam.
quests.done: That's the stuff! A ship of Adam wood can sail anywhere.

quests.start: CP9 tore up Iceburg and took Tom's blueprints. Lucci's their top dog. Here's his poster!
quests.done: The pigeon guy's down? That's what I call SUPER!

thanks: Need a ship fixed? Franky House does it all!

name: Brook
greeting: Yohohoho! May I see your... music collection?

quests.start: Milk is good for your bones! Could you bring me 3 buckets? Yohohoho!
quests.done: Ahh, my bones feel stronger already! Not that I have muscles. Yohohoho!

quests.start: I promised a little whale, Laboon, that I would come back to the Twin Capes. Please go and see if he still waits.
quests.done: He's still waiting... After fifty years. My eyes are full of tears! Though I have no eyes. Yohoho...

quests.start: Gecko Moria stole my shadow and left me in the dark. Here is his poster. Help me get it back!
quests.done: I can walk in the sun again! Thank you! Yohohoho!

thanks: Shall I play you a song? Binks' Sake, perhaps?

name: Jinbe
greeting: Fish-Man Karate is about the water in all things.

quests.start: The Ryugu Palace on Fish-Man Island needs repairs. Bring 10 prismarine shards.
quests.done: Thank you. The children will be safe.

quests.start: Tell Luffy that I will join his crew once I leave Big Mom's.
quests.done: He laughed and said 'Of course!' That sounds like him.

quests.start: Big Mom won't let anyone leave her crew alive. Here is her poster. Be careful.
quests.done: You bested an Emperor. I am in your debt.

quests.start: Chopper wants to visit Doctor Kureha on Drum Island. The seas are rough, so go with him.
quests.done: A doctor who looks after his own teacher. That is a fine young man.

thanks: The sea is calm today.

name: Shanks
greeting: Let's have a drink first.

quests.start: A party needs drinks! Bring me 4 honey bottles.
quests.done: Now we're talking! Cheers!

quests.start: Give Luffy my regards. Tell him to come return my hat when he's a great pirate.
quests.done: Hahaha! He said he'll give it back himself? Good.

quests.start: Eustass Kid is heading for Elbaph. Let's teach him some manners. Here's his poster.
quests.done: One strike. Not bad at all.

quests.start: Teach gave me these scars. He's too dangerous to leave alone. Here's his poster.
quests.done: You did it. Now THAT deserves a party!

thanks: Take care of that hat.

name: Marshall D. Teach (Blackbeard)
greeting: Zehahahaha! People's dreams never end!

name: Buggy
greeting: Who're you calling a big red nose?!

name: Edward Newgate (Whitebeard)
greeting: Gurarara! Bring it, brat!

name: Charlotte Linlin (Big Mom)
greeting: Life or treat?!

name: Kaido
greeting: Wololo... Let's have a fun fight!

name: Trafalgar D. Water Law
greeting: Room...

quests.start: I need surgical tools. Bring me 16 iron ingots.
quests.done: Good. These will do.

quests.start: Go tell Straw Hat I'm proposing an alliance. Don't make it weird.
quests.done: He said yes and called us friends. ...Great.

quests.start: Doflamingo took everything from me. Take his poster. We end this.
quests.done: It's over. ...Thank you.

quests.start: Big Mom is after us in Wano. Kid and I can't do it alone. Poster.
quests.done: An Emperor down. Not a bad day.

thanks: Don't get the wrong idea. We're just allies.

name: Eustass Kid
greeting: Get out of my way!

name: Killer
greeting: Fa fa fa...

name: Basil Hawkins
greeting: The cards say you will lose.

name: X Drake
greeting: Keep your voice down. I'm on a mission.

quests.start: I need to send a message to SWORD. Find Koby and tell him the mission continues.
quests.done: Good. Message delivered.

quests.start: Hawkins knows I'm a spy. Deal with him before he talks. Here's his poster.
quests.done: Good. My cover holds.

quests.start: Report to Garp. He's the one who backs SWORD.
quests.done: He's pleased? Then so am I.

thanks: SWORD sends its thanks.

name: Jewelry Bonney
greeting: You got food? I'm starving!

quests.start: Bring me 32 steaks. Right now!
quests.done: Mmmph! You're alright.

quests.start: Have you seen my dad? Big guy, Bible, paws. Tell him I'm looking for him.
quests.done: He... he said that? *sniff* Thanks.

quests.start: Kizaru is attacking Egghead. Here's his poster. Get him!
quests.done: Ha! Take that, admiral!

quests.start: Vegapunk has to get back to Egghead before the Marines find him. Take him there!
quests.done: He made it? Thank you... I owe you a feast.

thanks: Got any more food?

name: Dracule Mihawk
greeting: Show me what you have.

name: Sir Crocodile
greeting: Dreams are for the weak.

name: Donquixote Doflamingo
greeting: Fufufufu! Only the winners are justice!

name: Boa Hancock
greeting: Hmph. You may look upon me.

quests.start: Bring me eight roses. Only the finest for the Empress.
quests.done: ...They're beautiful. Not that I care.

quests.start: D-deliver this message to Luffy. Tell him... tell him I said hello!
quests.done: He said hello back?! *faints*

quests.start: Blackbeard attacked Amazon Lily to steal my power! Take his poster and punish him!
quests.done: You protected my island. You may stay... for now.

quests.start: Deliver this cake to my beloved Luffy... and if he asks, it's not from me! It is! Tell him it is!
quests.done: He said thank you?! *faints*

thanks: Have you seen Luffy?

name: Bartholomew Kuma
greeting: If you could go on a trip, where would you go?

quests.start: I've lost my Bible. Could you bring me a book?
quests.done: Thank you. This will do.

quests.start: Gecko Moria is stealing shadows. His poster.
quests.done: Thank you. Now... where shall I send you?

quests.start: Please watch over my daughter Bonney. Tell her I'm proud of her.
quests.done: Thank you. That is all I wanted.

thanks: If you could go on a trip, where would you go?

name: Gecko Moria
greeting: Kishishishi! Your shadow is mine!

name: Monkey D. Garp
greeting: Bwahahaha! Fist of Love!

quests.start: Bring me 16 bread. I mean rice crackers. Bread's fine.
quests.done: *munch munch* Good kid!

quests.start: Go check on my student Koby. Make sure he's training!
quests.done: Ha! He's doing push-ups? Good boy.

quests.start: Kuzan was my student, and now he sails with Blackbeard. Bring him to his senses.
quests.done: Hmph. Good work. Have a rice cracker.

quests.start: Take these rice crackers to my grandson Luffy. And tell him to come home and become a Marine!
quests.done: He ate them all on the spot? Bwahaha! That's my boy.

thanks: Zzz...

name: Sengoku
greeting: Looking for bounties? I have plenty of posters.

quests.start: My goat is hungry and the Marine kitchen is out of hay. Bring me 16 wheat.
quests.done: She thanks you. So do I.

quests.start: Garp ate my rice crackers again. Go tell that fool to stay out of my office!
quests.done: He laughed and ate another one? ...Typical.

quests.start: Blackbeard stole Whitebeard's power at Marineford. I'm retired, but you aren't. Here's his poster.
quests.done: The man who started this era of chaos, beaten. Well done.

thanks: Have a rice cracker. Don't tell Garp.

name: Sakazuki (Akainu)
greeting: Absolute Justice!

name: Borsalino (Kizaru)
greeting: Ooh, scary...

name: Issho (Fujitora)
greeting: Let us roll the dice.

name: Aramaki (Ryokugyu)
greeting: I'll drain you dry.

name: Kuzan (Aokiji)
greeting: Ara ara... too much work.

name: Smoker
greeting: You're not escaping this time.

name: Koby
greeting: I'm going to be a Marine Admiral!

quests.start: I'm looking for Luffy-san. He saved me from Alvida! Can you find him and say hi for me?
quests.done: He remembered me? Amazing!

quests.start: Buggy the Clown is attacking Orange Town! Here's his poster. Please help!
quests.done: You did it! I'll train harder too!

quests.start: Vice Admiral Garp is training me. Tell him I'm ready for the next lesson!
quests.done: He said WHAT? ...Okay. One thousand push-ups it is.

thanks: I'll be an Admiral someday. Just watch!

name: Tashigi
greeting: Every sword deserves respect. Want one?

quests.start: Famous swords shouldn't be in the hands of pirates. Forge or find me a Tamahagane Katana.
quests.done: A fine blade. I'll keep it safe from pirates.

quests.start: Tell Captain Koby that G-5 is ready if he needs us.
quests.done: Good. G-5 is rough, but they're loyal.

quests.start: Crocodile nearly took over Alabasta and a pirate had to stop him. Not this time. Here's his poster.
quests.done: Justice was served by... you. I suppose I should thank you.

thanks: Have you seen my glasses? ...Oh, they're on my head.

name: Rob Lucci
greeting: Justice is whatever we say it is.

name: Monkey D. Dragon
greeting: The wind is changing.

quests.start: Tell Sabo the Revolutionary Army gathers at Baltigo.
quests.done: Good. The plan moves forward.

quests.start: Kuma was my friend. Find him and tell him we have not forgotten.
quests.done: Thank you.

quests.start: The admiral Ryokugyu hunts my people. Here's his poster.
quests.done: The world is one step freer.

quests.start: Go to the Gray Terminal. See with your own eyes what the nobles throw away.
quests.done: Now you understand why we fight.

thanks: Watch the horizon.

name: Sabo
greeting: Hey! Any friend of Luffy's is a friend of mine.

quests.start: Report to Dragon for me. Tell him Dressrosa is going well.
quests.done: Thanks! He's not much of a talker, huh?

quests.start: I bent my pipe again. Bring 16 iron ingots for a new one.
quests.done: Perfect! Good as new.

quests.start: Fujitora is a fair man, but he stands in our way. Here's his poster.
quests.done: Great job! Ace would be proud.

thanks: Next stop: the Revolution.

name: Portgas D. Ace
greeting: Thanks for looking after my little brother.

quests.start: I just ate, but I could eat more. Bring 16 porkchops! ...Zzz.
quests.done: Huh? Oh, food! Thanks!

quests.start: Smoker keeps chasing Luffy. Mind giving him some smoke of his own?
quests.done: Ha! You've got guts.

quests.start: Teach killed a crewmate and ran. As 2nd Division Commander, I'm going after him. Help me.
quests.done: You did what I couldn't. Thank you.

thanks: Zzz... oh, sorry, I fell asleep.

name: Marco
greeting: Yoi. What do you need?

quests.start: I'm a doctor these days, yoi. Bring 8 golden carrots for my patients.
quests.done: Thanks, yoi.

quests.start: Go see Ace. Tell him Pops says don't do anything reckless, yoi.
quests.done: He'll be reckless anyway, yoi.

quests.start: Akainu killed Ace. Here's his poster, yoi.
quests.done: Thank you. Ace can rest now.

thanks: I'm just a doctor now, yoi.

name: Silvers Rayleigh
greeting: Ah, young one. Want to learn Haki?

quests.start: Say hello to Shanks for me. He was a little cabin boy back then.
quests.done: He sent his regards? Good lad.

quests.start: Buggy's gotten full of himself. Take him down a peg, would you?
quests.done: Hahaha! He'll get over it.

quests.start: Kizaru again. I'm getting too old for this. Go on, poster's yours.
quests.done: Splendid! Your Haki is getting strong.

thanks: Let's have a drink at Shakky's.

name: Gol D. Roger
greeting: Wahahaha! My treasure? Go look for it!

quests.start: Find my partner Rayleigh. Tell him the voyage isn't over.
quests.done: Wahahaha! That's my first mate!

quests.start: Oden sailed with me to Laugh Tale. Go tell him I said thanks.
quests.done: He cried? Of course he did!

quests.start: Newgate and I fought for three days and nights. Let's see if you can do better.
quests.done: Wahahaha! You might find the One Piece after all!

quests.start: Every great voyage starts at the Twin Capes. Go stand where the Grand Line begins and feel it!
quests.done: Wahaha! You felt it, didn't you? That's the start of an adventure.

thanks: I'll be waiting at Laugh Tale.

name: Kozuki Oden
greeting: Ha! Wano is waiting to open its borders!

quests.start: Bring me 16 baked potatoes! I'll make a hot pot.
quests.done: Delicious! Now that's Oden!

quests.start: Tell Kin'emon that the Red Scabbards must be ready in 20 years.
quests.done: Good. They will be.

quests.start: King is Kaido's strongest commander. Here's his poster.
quests.done: Splendid! Wano is one step closer to freedom.

thanks: Boiled in oil? That's nothing!

name: Yamato
greeting: I am Kozuki Oden!

quests.start: I want to meet my hero, Oden! Tell him I've read his journal a hundred times.
quests.done: He knows who I am?! This is the best day!

quests.start: Help me build a snow fort! 16 packed ice please.
quests.done: Perfect! Like Onigashima's frozen halls.

quests.start: My father Kaido keeps Wano in chains. Here's his poster. Let's free Wano!
quests.done: Wano is free! Can I sail with you now?

thanks: I want to see the world like Oden did.

name: Charlotte Katakuri
greeting: I can see the future.

name: King
greeting: You think you can stand against the Beasts?

name: Enel
greeting: Yahahaha! I am God!

name: Kin'emon
greeting: Greetings, friend of Lord Oden!

quests.start: Our raid needs blades. Bring 24 iron ingots.
quests.done: Splendid! Our swords will be sharp.

quests.start: Ask Luffy if the Straw Hats will fight beside the samurai of Wano.
quests.done: He agreed! Wonderful!

quests.start: Hawkins guards the path to Onigashima. Here is his poster.
quests.done: The way is clear. For Wano!

quests.start: Lord Oden longs for the taste of Wano. Carry this grilled fish to him, with my respects.
quests.done: He smiled? Then my duty as a retainer is done.

thanks: For Wano!

name: Dr. Vegapunk
greeting: Science will save the future! Need anything?

quests.start: Science needs materials! Bring me 8 Wapometal ingots for my next invention.
quests.done: Excellent! The lab will put these to good use.

quests.start: The Void Century hides the truth of this world. Go to its ruins and tell me what you see.
quests.done: So the ruins remain... The world deserves to know what happened.

quests.start: Kizaru was sent to Egghead to silence me. He's not a bad man, but he follows orders. Stop him.
quests.done: You stopped a light-speed Admiral? My data never predicted that!

thanks: Knowledge belongs to everyone. Stop by any time.

name: Magellan
greeting: ...Excuse me, I need the bathroom first. Then I'll deal with you.

name: Emporio Ivankov
greeting: Hee-haw! Welcome to Newkama Land, candy boy!

quests.start: Newkama Land needs more color! Bring Iva-sama 8 pink tulips, hee-haw!
quests.done: Ve-ry good, candy boy!

quests.start: Straw-boy is Dragon's son! Go tell him Iva-sama is on his side!
quests.done: He remembers me? Hee-haw!

quests.start: Magellan's poison guards the lowest floors of Impel Down. Beat him so we can all break out! Here's his poster.
quests.done: FREEDOM! A Death Wink of thanks, hee-haw!

thanks: Miracles happen to those who never give up, hee-haw!

name: Imu
greeting: ...You have seen too much.

name: Loki
greeting: Free me from these chains... and I'll show you why Elbaph fears its prince.

name: Rocks D. Xebec
greeting: Ha! I'll take the head of God himself... and you're in my way!

name: Queen the Plague
greeting: Murrrrrrrrrr! You're late for the show, prisoner!

name: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn
greeting: Bugs. All of you. Kneel.

name: Hody Jones
greeting: Humans belong at the bottom of the sea. I'll put you there myself!

name: Figarland Shamrock
greeting: So you're the one my brother bet on. The Holy Land will judge that.

name: Saint Gunko
greeting: Elbaph broke the Holy Land's rules. Rules are rules. No ifs, no buts.
